title: Zedekiah's Rebellion and the Fall of Jerusalem
description: King Zedekiah rebels against the king of Babylon, and Nebuchadnezzar lays siege to Jerusalem for a year and a half. The famine becomes so severe that the city eventually falls. Zedekiah flees but is caught on the plains of Jericho and brought to Nebuchadnezzar at Riblah. There he watches his sons be slaughtered before he himself is blinded, bound with bronze chains, and taken to Babylon, where he remains in prison until the day of his death.
